title: Ecos Dire Wolf Resource Pack
description: A resource pack that adds new dire wolf variants for the existing wolf based on the Roblox game Ecos La Brea.
body:
Adds new variants of the wolf that are based off the dire wolf from the Roblox Game 'Ecos: La Brea', all design inspiration comes from the developers of that game.

The Ecos Dire Wolf Datapack is required for these variants to spawn.

Note: When spawning naturally packs will consist of only 1 of the 4 variants, this does not mean that the other variants are not spawning properly.
